'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I've been thinking about that thing we discussed last time. Have people really become kinder with the development of civilization? Do they really go hand in hand? All this time, where we believe there is civilization, life has become more comfortable, easier. There were increasingly fewer worries about safety or getting something to eat. It's easy to be humane when nothing is threatening you. The answer to these questions was right before my eyes. The situation in Tarkov has shown us how much kinder we have become. Once the issues of survival came to the front, it turned out that decent people aren’t more common than maybe 500 years ago. There're probably even less of them now. What do you think, are you one of them? Okay, don’t overthink it. I need you to do something for me. However, you will need to remember quite a lot for this job. Practice in memorizing large volumes of information, I’ll contact you later.}}

== Requirements== 
* Must be level 15 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Reach the required [[Attention|Attention skill]] level of 8

==Rewards==
* +8,600 [[EXP]]
*[[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.01'''</font>
* 150,000 Roubles
** 157,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 172,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope]]
{{quote|Seventh digit after the decimal separator in the pi number? IIO? Okay, when the time comes, I'll contact you.}}
